question: Should `createChannelIngressMonitor` become a supported public plugin-SDK contract for external channel plugins, or should this phase remain an internal bundled-channel refactor until that contract is explicitly designed?
rationale: The PR deliberately exports a new lifecycle and delivery API through the established plugin SDK, creating a compatibility commitment that cannot be safely inferred from three pilot migrations alone.

options.title: Approve the public SDK seam
options.body: Keep the public export after a channel-area owner confirms the lifecycle, payload, retry, and shutdown contract and the PR adds live behavior proof.

options.title: Keep phase A internal
options.body: Use an internal shared helper for the three bundled pilots and defer any external plugin-SDK API until there is a dedicated compatibility proposal.

recommendation.title: Approve the public SDK seam
recommendation.body: Keep the public export after a channel-area owner confirms the lifecycle, payload, retry, and shutdown contract and the PR adds live behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR commits, assignment, and stated maintainer-requested consolidation make this the strongest available routing candidate, though repository-history ownership was not independently confirmed.
